assessments.reasoning: The SPDX detail JSON covers 46,726 contiguous bytes, SHA-256 a40b1d3295d3714a6eab2b48c0b65f9a2321372369a797bcf61d4d2a8b63fc0f. It records CC-BY-NC-ND-1.0, isDeprecatedLicenseId false, and the exact by-nd-nc publisher URL in both citation fields. Its licenseText begins “Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivs-NonCommercial 1.0.”
The SPDX repository's unsigned annotated tag object names v3.29.0 and directly targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. The generated NC-ND file was inspected at that commit.

The capture at the exact by-nd-nc/1.0/legalcode citation reports the claim's publisher digest. The main title, inline title and CC BY-ND-NC 1.0 label preserve the publisher's ordering. The canonical link adds .en.

The cited publisher body's opening fine print refers to distribution of “THIS DRAFT LICENSE.” The generated licenseText carries the same warning. Repetition provides no independent basis to decide its legal significance. The exact ID and source citation remain supported.

challenge.method: Read licenseId, name, licenseText, crossRef and seeAlso literally. Tested the tempting reconstruction of a by-nc-nd URL from the SPDX identifier, and compared the cited URL with the publisher's /legalcode.en declaration and the neighboring BY-NC reference.
challenge.results: The reconstructed by-nc-nd path fails the literal comparison. Both SPDX citation fields use by-nd-nc/1.0/legalcode, exactly matching the captured URL. The SPDX display name orders Non Commercial before No Derivatives, while its licenseText heading and the publisher title order NoDerivs before NonCommercial.

limitations: This is an identifier-to-cited-URL finding. The differently ordered labels, generated text, publisher HTML and translations have no established general or legal equivalence. Draft significance, finality, legal effect, downstream grants and redistribution remain unresolved.

The publisher digest measures the acquired /legalcode HTML. Equality with canonical /legalcode.en and application across project files remain untested. Index lifecycle, publisher currency, SPDX deprecation and release authorization have distinct authorities.
